## Lifetime and composition

- Harness-owned ChannelObservation already survives child subtests and process
  stop/start, then closes with the harness; use it for storage witnesses.
  Provider intent observation retains its existing close/reopen ordering at each
  real process restart. Never retain an intent reader across a process switch.
- The seven seed helper uses are direct typed calls; the census also reports
  sibling references, including the budget diagnostic's generic scanner use.
  Any indirect/shadowed/excluded reference must reject the finite transform.
- Existing history intersections: 18 recipe rows and 18 transition rows;
  channel-anchor preimages 10, channel-decision 3, channel-event-count 9,
  channel-intent 15, global-event-name 3, served-setup-role 2, source-blob 1.
  Keep all signed Before/original recipe bytes/order and compose one new finite
  current-source inverse before these older owners. No broad regeneration.
- Whole-file/source-donor readers: migrate-channel-intents, migrate-global-event-name,
  internal/sourceblob and internal/globalname. New source membership is enumerated
  up front; preserve their historical inventories, not arbitrary new exclusions.
- The complete current #2617 file list has no channel-family/source-owner overlap.
  The 611 runtimepersistence construction sites remain read-only audit territory.
- Before any real ratchet: compile plus limited vet, then one integrated
  history/source pass. Default vet's previously disclosed diagnostics are not
  represented as a default-vet pass. Downward + committed read-only ratchet once
  at the combined checkpoint; carry unaffected receipts.

Request one consolidated owner/scope disposition for the missing cuts above;
independent existing-owner propagation proceeds meanwhile. No per-reader gate.
